name: auto-dash-back-end
description: RPI4 CAN interface with web socket server and web server

scripts.init_and_start_vcan_server: echo 'Creates/configures vcan0, then starts the development dashboard. See: npm run help' && ./RPI_system/start_vcan.sh && npm run test_server
scripts.start_vcan_server: echo 'Starts the production dashboard listening on vcan0. See: npm run help' && NODE_ENV=production CHANNEL=vcan0 TYPE=live node index.js
scripts.can_server: echo 'Starts the production dashboard using the auto-detected vehicle CAN interface. See: npm run help' && NODE_ENV=production TYPE=live node index.js
scripts.test_server: echo 'Starts the development dashboard on vcan0 without creating the interface. See: npm run help' && NODE_ENV=development TYPE=development CHANNEL=vcan0 node index.js
scripts.replay_logs: echo 'Replays all logs or one named log after the dashboard connects (default 10x). Run npm run replay_logs:help.' && NODE_ENV=production STARTUP_MODE=replay_logs node index.js

author: Michael J Mathews II
